messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: SimpleQuestion_ask
function.description: Presents a simple question based on the provided context and expects an answer from a predefined set of options. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

question.description: The question posed to the user.

answer.description: The selected answer to the question, which must be one of the provided options.

context.description: The context or scenario in which the question is being asked, providing additional information to the user.

message.content:
Below is a concise list of the long‑weekend periods in Canada for the year 2023.  
These are the national public holidays that either fall on a Friday or Monday (or are observed on the nearest weekday) and therefore create a three‑day weekend.  

| Long‑Weekend Period | Holiday(s) Involved | Notes |
|---------------------|---------------------|-------|
| **Jan 1–3, 2023** | New Year’s Day (observed on Jan 2) | New Year’s Day falls on Sunday, so the observed holiday on Monday extends the weekend. |
| **Feb 18–20, 2023** | Family Day (Ontario, BC, AB, SK, MB, NB, PE) | Family Day is on the third Monday in February. |
| **Mar 31–Apr 2, 2023** | Good Friday | Good Friday is on Friday, March 31. |
| **May 20–22, 2023** | Victoria Day | Victoria Day is on the Monday preceding May 25. |
| **Jul 1–3, 2023** | Canada Day (observed on Jul 3) | Canada Day falls on Saturday, so the observed holiday on Monday extends the weekend. |
| **Sep 2–4, 2023** | Labour Day | Labour Day is on the first Monday in September. |
| **Oct 7–9, 2023** | Thanksgiving | Thanksgiving is on the second Monday in October. |
| **Nov 11–13, 2023** | Remembrance Day (observed on Nov 13) | Remembrance Day falls on Saturday, so the observed holiday on Monday extends the weekend. |
| **Dec 23–26, 2023** | Christmas & Boxing Day | Christmas is on Monday, Boxing Day on Tuesday. The weekend includes both holidays. |

> **Pro tip:** If you’re targeting a specific province, remember that some provinces have additional holidays (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, Heritage Day in Saskatchewan, etc.) that can also create long weekends. The table above covers the nationwide holidays that affect all Canadians.
